name: Classic Settings
author: MasterAlexS
description: Gives the settings menu the classic Dungeon Rampage wooden board, red ribbon banner, and styled labels.
longDescription:
Brings the authentic pre-1.0 Dungeon Rampage look and feel to the settings screen:

- **Classic Wooden Board**: Replaces the modern yellow-and-black hazard border and dark paint splats with the iconic wooden plank board and metallic corner rivets from the town interface (`db_UI_town.swf`).
- **Curved Red Ribbon Banner**: Adds the classic red ribbon banner behind the "SETTINGS" title, scaled cleanly so the original comic text fits naturally.
- **Accurate Close Button**: Positions the close button ("X") right at the intersection of the top and right iron frame bars.
- **Warm Fantasy Typography**:
  - Category tabs and setting titles in bold gold (`#FFCC00`).
  - Setting descriptions in readable parchment tan (`#D4C4B0`).
  - Values and the reset button in clean white.
  - Soft, feathered drop shadows across all text for improved readability and that authentic retro comic feel.
- **100% Native & Compatible**: Leaves all game controls (checkboxes, sliders, dropdowns, keybinds, and scrollbars) completely intact and functional, with zero gameplay bugs or mod conflicts.
